title: The Lantern Moth
statement: Born among moths who flung themselves into every flame, she alone wondered what the light was for, so she learned to carry a small lantern instead, drifting beside lost travelers and asking where they hoped to go, never pretending to know a road she hadn't seen. The sky kept her for her curiosity; on clear nights her wings still flicker, as if she's leaning in to hear one more question.
